proposed_claim: V7 measured source-aware coverage across accessible prior resources.
allowed_interpretation: Coverage in the four complete row-level snapshots named in the report.
prohibited_inference: Global novelty; absence from every public resource; effect-size agreement.

proposed_claim: The project supplies explicit source/phenotype harmonization metadata.
allowed_interpretation: Definitions, source identifiers, effect coding, ancestry/build metadata and explicit unknowns are included in the candidate package.
prohibited_inference: Byte-identical raw-source recovery; verified per-variant INFO/N; complete participant overlap.

proposed_claim: Uncertainty is qualified at the reported marginal-estimate level.
allowed_interpretation: Pointwise marginal uncertainty and diagnostic flags can be reported for each estimate.
prohibited_inference: Calibrated covariance between estimates; phenotype measurement-error calibration; valid between-fit tests.

proposed_claim: The atlas supports bounded source-aware research use cases.
allowed_interpretation: Examples retrieve published marginal estimates with source definitions, testing-family status and caveats.
prohibited_inference: New association, causal pathway, clinically equivalent phenotype, or mechanism.

proposed_claim: A machine-readable release candidate is built and integrity-checked.
allowed_interpretation: The bounded candidate can be rebuilt and machine-parsed; independent checks passed for the defined consumer scope.
prohibited_inference: Permission to publicly deposit all source-derived outputs before source-specific rights review.

proposed_claim: Independent candidate quality/usability review passed for its defined scope.
allowed_interpretation: Automated independent review assessed actual data, joins and consumer queries; human investigators retain final review.
prohibited_inference: Human researcher user study, peer review, or empirical replication.

proposed_claim: The computational package is reproducible from committed result tables and frozen metadata.
allowed_interpretation: Candidate release build and V7 source-match inputs/code are identified by hashes.
prohibited_inference: Reproduction of unfinished raw-GWAS processing tails or upstream source access rights.

proposed_claim: The integrated project establishes a major new biological or methodological finding.
evidence: No new association, calibrated contrast, independent two-trait replication, or validated new method was generated.
allowed_interpretation: Do not make this claim in the current package.
prohibited_inference: Novel association, first-in-field claim, new method, causal mechanism, independent replication.
